algorithm_baseline.state: flat raster grid plus explicit frontier edges carrying wall and target coordinates
algorithm_baseline.start: one uniformly selected logical cell from independent bounded X and Y draws
algorithm_baseline.selection: uniform random frontier index with swap-pop removal
algorithm_baseline.acceptance: an edge is accepted only when its target logical cell remains unvisited
algorithm_baseline.frontier_inventory: every unique logical-grid edge is enqueued and popped exactly once; stale edges are skipped
algorithm_baseline.topology: every accepted edge adds exactly one new logical cell, producing a connected acyclic passage graph

property_corpus.extents: every odd width and height from 3 through 11
property_corpus.checks: logical V, exact unique-edge pop count E, V-1 passages, connected, acyclic, blocked border, and open logical cells

legacy_findings.typo_policy: must remain an ABI 1.x compatibility forwarder when the canonical checked API is added
legacy_findings.validation: legacy rejects dimensions below 3 but does not currently reject even extents
legacy_findings.rng: legacy uses the process-local generation seed; dispatcher already provides replayable checked routing
